   - Assessment/likely diagnosis: Atopic dermatitis (eczema) flare.
   - Treatment planned:
     - Prescribe a stronger topical corticosteroid (medication name/dose/route/frequency not documented).
     - Prescribe emollients for bathing/shower use and regular moisturization for 7–10 days (product/dose/route/frequency not documented).
     - Antihistamines discussed: OTC loratadine or chlorpheniramine; patient reported limited benefit previously. Offer prescription fexofenadine (dose/route/frequency not documented).
     - Keep a diary to identify potential triggers (e.g., soaps, detergents, clothing).
   - Follow-up plan:
     - Reassess after 7–10 days of treatment; return next week if not improving.
